# Bike words

The words the rider app uses.
Keep it short.

allow: check out our, roof rack
Extends: tech


## Dock
Description: A powered stand
where one bike is locked.

Avoid:
* rack: Racks are unpowered.
+ bay

Links:

- https://example.com/docs/docks

Notes: A station is a group of docks.

Good: Return the bike to any dock
